description:
Expose BenchBox's existing visualization infrastructure through the MCP server,
enabling AI agents to generate charts and visualizations from benchmark results.

Currently, the MCP server provides data-only tools (get_results, compare_results,
get_performance_trends) but cannot generate visual outputs. The visualization
module at benchbox/core/visualization/ has mature Plotly-based charting
capabilities that should be accessible via MCP.

This enables AI agents to:
- Generate performance comparison charts from benchmark results
- Create trend visualizations for regression analysis
- Export publication-ready charts in multiple formats
- Use pre-defined templates for common visualization patterns
